statement: For complex A of dimension2 or3 the actual Jacobian-summand property is equivalent to integral algebraicity of P^(2g−2)/(2g−2)! on A x Adual.
depends_on: C.4n; C.4p; integral Matsusaka identity; Voisin2024 Theorem1.4; Beckmann–deGaayFortman2023 Theorem1.1
notes: Exact reformulation as a dimension-two cycle class; no assertion that the remaining class is algebraic and no priority claim.

statement: Every supersingular abelian surface over every algebraically closed field of positive characteristic is an actual direct summand of a product of Jacobians.
depends_on: Fu–Li2021 Proposition6.1 p184 and Lemma6.2 p185; C.4f
notes: The source explicitly includes characteristic2; does not address all nonsupersingular surfaces.
